description: Ethiopian Air Force gunship captured by the TPLF and displayed in the open-air section of the Hawelti martyrs' memorial complex. Presence last independently recorded in 2015. The museum was looted during the Tigray war and an April 2024 visitor review confirms the site is open again but does not itemise the outdoor hardware.
Captured Ethiopian Air Force fighter in the open-air section of the Hawelti memorial. Presence last independently recorded in 2015.

Captured Ethiopian Air Force strike aircraft in the open-air section of the Hawelti memorial. No serial recorded so tail_number is blank. Dark-tourism.com describes this airframe as a MiG-27 which is a misidentification. Ethiopia never operated the MiG-27 and Spottingmode records the type as MiG-23BN.
Sudanese-registered light twin preserved in the Hawelti memorial grounds alongside the captured military hardware. An unusual inclusion whose provenance is not documented in any source found.
